KPI_1.name: M1 Opportunities Created Count for Non-Closed Won Deals
KPI_1.description: Tracks the count of M1 stage opportunities created, excluding closed won deals and focusing on expansion and new customer opportunities with positive ACV.

KPI_2.name: M1 Starting ACV for Non-Closed Won Deals
KPI_2.description: Measures the total starting ACV value for M1 stage opportunities, excluding closed won deals and focusing on expansion and new customer opportunities.

KPI_3.name: S0 Opportunities Created Count for Non-Closed Won Deals
KPI_3.description: Tracks the count of S0 stage opportunities created, excluding closed won deals and focusing on expansion and new customer opportunities with positive ACV.

KPI_4.name: S0 Starting ACV for Non-Closed Won Deals
KPI_4.description: Measures the total starting ACV value for S0 stage opportunities, excluding closed won deals and focusing on expansion and new customer opportunities.

KPI_5.name: S1 Opportunities Created Count for Non-Closed Won Deals
KPI_5.description: Tracks the count of S1 stage opportunities created, excluding closed won deals and focusing on expansion and new customer opportunities with positive ACV.

KPI_6.name: S1 Starting ACV for Non-Closed Won Deals
KPI_6.description: Measures the total starting ACV value for S1 stage opportunities, excluding closed won deals and focusing on expansion and new customer opportunities.

KPI_7.name: S1 Opportunities by Non-Null Creator Team
KPI_7.description: Tracks S1 opportunities created by teams with assigned creator teams, excluding closed won deals and focusing on expansion and new customer opportunities.

KPI_8.name: S0 Opportunities by Non-Null Creator Team
KPI_8.description: Tracks S0 opportunities created by teams with assigned creator teams, excluding closed won deals and focusing on expansion and new customer opportunities.

KPI_9.name: M1 Opportunities by Non-Null Creator Team
KPI_9.description: Tracks M1 opportunities created by teams with assigned creator teams, excluding closed won deals and focusing on expansion and new customer opportunities.

KPI_10.name: All Opportunities ACV for Active Deals
KPI_10.description: Measures the total ACV for all active opportunities with positive value, excluding closed won deals and focusing on expansion and new customer opportunities.

attributes: Opportunity Type, Opportunity Stage, Opportunity Creator Profile, Opportunity Source Detailed, Opportunity Owner Name
goal: Monitor sales pipeline progression and opportunity creation performance across different stages (M1, S0, S1) to track weekly and monthly lead generation effectiveness and team productivity.
user_context: Sales leaders, revenue operations managers, and sales development representatives use this dashboard during weekly and monthly sales meetings to analyze pipeline generation performance across different opportunity stages (M1, S0, S1), comparing current week, last week, and 8-week trends by examining both opportunity counts and ACV values, drilling down by individual contributors, teams, opportunity sources, and creator profiles to identify top performers, underperforming areas, and pipeline health, while focusing on new customer and expansion opportunities and filtering out closed-won deals to concentrate on active pipeline creation and progression.
